headline: Cold-chain startup cannot secure stable reefer spare-parts flow and faces fragmented veterinary/transport compliance audits
desc: The startup serves poultry and dairy corridors but cannot guarantee compressor spare parts lead-time. Regional checkpoints require inconsistent paper manifests and temperature logs from multiple systems.
frictionCostMonthlyDZD: 2 140 000 DZD (fuel detours + spoilage + emergency rental units)
incidentSnapshot: May 2026: three delivery routes canceled after audit dispute over handwritten cleaning certificate despite ERP export being available.
bureaucracyNoise: Veterinary inspection checklist revised without notice
Transport authority requests stamped route declarations
Insurer requires extra telemetry evidence before claim processing
freeform: Potential upside is huge, but current process maturity is low and local maintenance vendors demand prepayment in hard currency for critical parts.

venture: distributed supplier mesh for light-industrial startups
title: Supplier-onboarding friction: tax IDs mismatch, bank KYC lag, and cross-wilaya transport permits break launch timelines
description_dirty: New startup operators trying to onboard 30+ suppliers are blocked by incomplete fiscal records, delayed bank account verification, and permit windows that do not align with procurement cycles.
frictionCostMonthlyDZD: Approx. 1,760,000 DZD plus hidden opportunity cost
last_real_case: March 2026: launch delayed 5 weeks after two strategic suppliers failed onboarding due to expired tax extract and missing notarized statutes.
rawTextBlob: \nFounders currently rely on ad-hoc intermediaries to accelerate paperwork. Risk concentration is high because only two coordinators understand the full multi-agency sequence.
